verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export feature, bulk download, or open-format data portability for GitHub Projects. The only related evidence is that the GraphQL API can query project items. That is a developer building block a user could use to build an export, not a first-party export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can query the API to find information about items in your project.
